**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

The matched mobile UI outputs show extra weather labels in Flare and the specified wind/humidity card in Sunburst. Exact generation and edit prompts remain linked at the source. Cited CellCog API timings and older DEV 2.5 tests are not these works. Source files are 1000-pixel WebP editorial exports, not claimed raw 1536-pixel generation files.
